latest.title: Research note: are returned XRR fit endpoints basin minima?
latest.result: Returned fit endpoints stand for their basins (supported); a few wrong basins need ≥ 10⁴ counts.

latest.title: Basin minimum validation: full run, results and verdicts
latest.result: Endpoint S₁ represents its basin (supported); 5 R2a and 1 X2e wrong basins need ≥ 10⁴ counts.
